k.v: उत्तरा दिगुदीची स्याद्दिश्यं तु त्रिषु दिग्भवे। अवाग्भवमवाचीनमुदीचीनमुदग्भवम्. प्रत्यग्भवं प्रतीचीनं प्राचीनं प्राग्भवं त्रिषु। इन्द्रो वह्निः पितृपतिर्नैरृतो वरुणो मरुत्.

उदीचीन &c. See p. 184, col. 2.
a: उदीचीन — a. 1 Turned towards the north. --2 Northern.

k.v: उत्तरा दिगुदीची स्याद्दिश्यं तु त्रिषु दिग्भवे। अवाग्भवमवाचीनमुदीचीनमुदग्भवम्. प्रत्यग्भवं प्रतीचीनं प्राचीनं प्राग्भवं त्रिषु। इन्द्रो वह्निः पितृपतिर्नैरृतो वरुणो मरुत्.

m: उदीचीनकुम्ब mf(आ)n. with the broad end to the north, Hir.
उदीचीन—प्रवण mfn. sloping towards the north, ŚBr.
उदीची-पथ m. N. of Northern India, Inscr.

v: tri॰ udac + BavArTe yat udyAdeSaH allope dIGaH uttaradigdeSakAlaBave । “SarErusrErivodIcyAnudDarizyan rasAniva” raGuH । 2 karmasamAptO karttavye dakziRAdidAnAdirUpe karmAdO ca । “aSvatarIraTAnudIcyezu” kAtyA॰ 22, 2, 25 । “aSvatarIyuktAn raTAnudIcyezu dadAti” karkaH । yaTA homAdO prakftahomAnantaraM karttavyodakAYjalisekadi । yaTAha saM॰ ta॰ “aTodIcyakarma, tatra goBilaH । “samiDamADAyAnuparyyukzya taTEvodakAYjalIn siYcet anvamaMsTAH” iti yaTAyaTamUhyam । udIcyadeSASca SarAvatyAH paScimottarasTA deSaBedAste ca matsyapurARe darSitAH yaTA “vAhlIkA vAwaDAnASca ABIrAH kAlatoyakAH । paranDrAScEva SUdrASca pahlavAScAtmaKaRqikAH । gAnDArA javanAScEva sinDusOvIramadrakAH । SakA druhyAH pulindASca pAradA hAramUrttikAH । rAmaWAH kaRWakArASca kekayA deSaBAnikAH । kzatriyopaniveSASca vESyaSUdrakulAni ca । Atreyo'Ta BaradvAjaH prasTalAH sadaSerakAH । lampakAstalagAnASca sEnikAH sahasAkujEH ete deSA udIcyAstu purAREH parikIrttitAH” । vfhatsaM॰ kUrmmaviBAge tu anyeeva te uktA yaTA “uttarataH kElAso himavAnvasumAn girirDanuzmAMSca । krOYco meruH kuravastayottarAH kzudramInASca । kekayavasAtiyAmunaBogaprasTArjunAyanAgnIDrAH । AdarSAntadvIpitrigartaturagAnanASvamuKAH । keSaDaracipiwanAsikadAserakavAwaDAnaSaraDAnAH । takzaSilApuzkalAvatakElAvatakaRWaDAnASca । ambaramadrakamAlavapOravakacCAradaRqapiNgalakAH । mARahalahURakohalaSItakamARqavaBUtapurAH । ganDArayaSovatihematAlarAjanyaKacaragavyASca । yODeyadAsameyAHSyAmAkAH kzemaDUrttASca” anayorviroDaparihAraH apekzABedAt nAmAntarAnulleKAcca boDyaH ।
m: उदीच्य mfn. being or living in the north, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 101; AV.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
उदीच्य (अस्), m. the country to the north and west of the river Sarasvatī, the northern region, MBh.
उदीच्य (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of that country, MBh.; R.; Ragh.; VarBṛS. &c.
उदीच्य m. N. of a school, VāyuP.
उदीच्य (अम्), n. a kind of perfume, Suśr.; Bhpr.
a: उदीच्य — a. Situated or living in the north. --च्यः 1 The country to the north and west of the river Sarasvatī; northern country. --2 (pl.) The inhabitants of the north; R. 4. 66. --च्यं A kind of perfume. --Comp. --वृत्तं a kind of Vaitālīya metre.

k.v: देशः प्राग्दक्षिणः प्राच्य उदीच्यः पश्चिमोत्तरः। प्रत्यन्तो म्लेच्छदेशः स्यान्मध्यद्देशस्तु मध्यमः॥
बालं ह्रीबेरबर्हिष्ठोदीच्यं केशाम्बुनाम च। कालानुसार्यवृद्धाश्मपुष्पशीतशिवानि तु॥

v: strI “zaqvizame'zwO same kalAstASca same syurno nirantarAH । na samAtra parASritA kalA vEtAlIye'nte ralO guruH” ityupakramya “udIcyavfttirdvitIyalaH sakto'greRa BavedayugmayoH” vf॰ ra॰ ukte vEtAlIyaBede Cabdasi ।
m: उदीच्य—वृत्ति f. the custom of the Northerners, Āp. ii, 17, 17
a species of the Vaitālīya metre.

उद्-√ ईक्ष् Ā. -ईक्षते (once P. p. -ईक्षत्, BhP. xi, 30, 44) to look up to, ŚBr.; R.; to look at, regard, view, behold, ŚBr. xiv, 9, 1, 1; MBh.; Mn. &c.; to wait, delay, hesitate; to expect, MBh.; R.; Mn.
a: उदीक्ष् — {c1c} A. 1 To look up to, look at, view, behold; सप्रणाममुदीक्षिताः Ku. 6. 7, 7. 67; Amaru. 71. --2 To expect, look out for, wait for, शत्रुव्यसनं Mu. 4; त्रीणि वर्षाण्युदीक्षेत कुमार्यृतुमती सती Ms. 9. 90.

m: उद्-ईक्षा f. id., BhP.
expecting, waiting Comm. on Bādar.

v: na॰ uda + Ikza--lyuw । 1 UrdDvadarSane 2 udBAvane ca ।
m: उद्-ईक्षण n. the act of looking up, seeing, beholding, L.
a: उदीक्षणं — 1 Looking up to. --2 Seeing, beholding, seeking.

m: उद्-ईक्षित mfn. looked at, beheld &c.

v: avya॰ ud + Ikza--lyap । 1 UrdDvaM dfzwvetyarTe 2 udBAvyetyarTe ca । karmaRi Ryat । 3 udBAvanIye 4 udIkzaRIye ca tri॰
m: उद्-ईक्ष्य ind.p. having looked at or beheld &c.

v: tri॰ udgatA ApoyataH ac samA॰ Itvam । udgatajale deSe ।
m: उद्-ईप mfn. (fr. 2. अप् with उद्; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 97), inundated, flooded
उद्-ईप m. high water, inundation, Rājat.
a: उदीप — a. [उद्गता आपो यत्र, अप ईप्] Flooded. --पः High water, inundation, flood.

m: उद्-√ ईर् Ā. -ईर्ते (3. pl. -ईरते, RV.; AV.; Impv. 2. sg. -ईर्ष्व, RV. x, 18, 8; AV.; impf. -ऐरत, RV. vii, 39, 1; p. -ईराण, AV. xii, 1, 28; RV.) P. (Subj. 3. sg. -ईरत्, RV. iv, 2, 7; aor. 2. du. -ऐरतम्, RV. i, 118, 6) to bring or fetch out of RV. i, 118, 6; to rise, start off (in order to go or to come), RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; to move upwards, ascend; to arise, originate, RV.; AV.; to honour, respect, RV. iv, 2, 7; (in class. Sanskṛt only उद्-ईर्ण occurs) : Caus. -ईरयति, to bring or fetch out of RV. i, 112, 5; x, 39, 9; to cause to rise or move; to raise, rouse, excite, RV.; MBh.; R.; Ragh.; Daś.; to throw or cast upwards; to cast, discharge, drive forward, R.; Ragh. &c.; to cause to come forth or appear, Kum.; to raise one's voice; to utter, speak, RV.; Yājñ.; Mn. &c.; to procure, cause, effect, RV. i, 48, 2; x, 39, 2; TS.; Suśr.; to excite, raise, enhance, multiply, increase, Suśr.; Kum. &c.; to extol, glorify, RV. v, 42, 3; MBh.; to stir up, urge, stimulate, RV.; R.; to rise, start off, RV. v, 55, 5; viii, 7, 3: Pass. -ईर्यते, to be cast or thrown upwards, R.; to be excited, be roused or stirred up, MBh.; R.; Suśr.; Kum. &c.; to be uttered or announced or enunciated; to pass for, VP.; Kum.; Kathās.; Pañcat.; Suśr. &c.; to sound; to issue forth.
a: उदीर् — {c2c} A. [उद्-ईर्] 1 To rise (sound &c.); उदैरत रणितानि Dk. 123 were heard. --2 To start (to go or come). --3 To move upwards, ascend, go up. --4 To arise, originate. --Caus. 1 To cause to rise or move. --2 To utter, pronounce, speak; गिरमुदीरयति K. 13; U. 5, 6; उदीरितोर्थः पशुनापि गृह्यते Pt. 1. 43; so आलोकशद्वं R. 2. 9. --3 To call, name; स भीमरूपः शिव इत्युदीर्यते Ku. 5. 77. --4 To put forth; यदशोकोयमुदीरयिष्यति R. 8. 62. --5 To cast, throw, roll down (as dice); उदीरयामास सलीलमक्षान् R. 6. 18; to discharge, drive forward. --6 To raise, throw up; उदीरितं रजः Śi. 12. 58; उदैरयच्छिरः Dk. 103 expanded its hood. --7 To display, manifest, make visible, cause; तिसृभिस्त्वमवस्थाभिर्महिमानमुदीरयन् Ku. 2. 6; Śi. 11. 7. --8 To bring about, effect; Ki. 13. 28. --9 To rouse, excite, stimulate; उदीरितेंद्रियः Ku. 4. 41; ˚धी acuteminded. --pass. 1 To be cast or thrown upwards, excited, uttered &c. --2 To sound. --3 To issue forth.

m: उद्-ईर्ण mfn. issued out, excited, increased, elevated, MBh.; R.; Suśr.; Kum. &c.
self-conceited, proud, MBh.
a: उदीर्ण — p. p. [ईर्-क्त] 1 Grown, ascended, risen, produced, caused; Śi. 18. 37. --2 Puffed up, elated, grown haughty; भवल्लब्धवरोदीर्णस्तारकाख्यो महासुरः Ku. 2. 32. --3 Excited, stimulated, roused; Śi. 1. 32; Dk. 43, 47. --4 Increased, intense. --5 Generous, great; excellent. --6 Uttered, pronounced; Śi. 13. 42. --7 Ready, strung; ˚धन्वा U. 5. 11. --र्णः N. of Viṣṇu. --Comp. --दीधिति a. intensely bright. --वेग a. violent, impetuous in its course (as a torrent).

m: उद्-ईर्ण—दीधिति mfn. intensely bright.
उद्-ईर्ण—ता f. excitement, activity, agility, Suśr.
उद्-ईर्ण—वराहतीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha.
उद्-ईर्ण—वेग mfn. impetuous in its course (as a torrent), violent.

throwing out
exciting, stirring up, Car.
saying, speaking, communicating, Kum.; Kathās.; Sāh.

animated, agitated
increased, augmented

to be uttered &c.
